title: Think Shallow, Solve Deep: Controlling Recurrent Dynamics for Reliable Test-Time Depth
abstract: arXiv:2608.18222v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recurrent-depth reasoners aim to solve harder problems by iterating their update longer at test time, but additional iterations can improve, preserve, or degrade an answer. We show that a measurable property of the trained operator, its finite-time dynamical regime (estimated as settling, marginal, or drifting), indicates which of these occurs. We give a sufficient condition for depth-safety: once an operator's per-step displacement is small relative to the decoder margin, the decoded answer cannot change under further iterations. Empirically, on algorithmic tasks trained from $800$ unaugmented examples per difficulty tier, settling operators do not degrade with added depth, and on some tasks convert it into higher accuracy on harder unseen instances (Sudoku, $0.19$ to $0.34$ past the training horizon). translated_title: 浅层思考，深层解决：控制循环动力学以实现可靠的测试时深度推理
translated_abstract: 循环深度推理器旨在通过在测试时更长时间地迭代其更新来解决更困难的问题，但额外的迭代可能会改善、保持或降低答案的质量。我们展示了训练后算子的一个可测量属性——其有限时间动力学状态（估计为稳定、边缘或漂移）——能够指示上述哪种情况发生。我们给出了深度安全性的一个充分条件：一旦算子的每步位移相对于解码器余量较小，解码后的答案在进一步迭代下便不会改变。在实验上，对于从每个难度层级仅用800个未增强样本训练的算法任务，稳定算子不会因增加深度而性能下降，并且在某些任务上，它将额外深度转化为在更难的未见实例上的更高准确性（例如数独，在训练范围之外的准确率从0.19提升至0.34）。一个单一的终端不动点目标能够同时改变动力学状态和深度行为：移除它会导致漂移并消除该增益。
tldr: 本文发现循环深度推理器中算子的有限时间动力学状态（稳定、边缘或漂移）可预测额外迭代的收益，并证明稳定算子能保证深度安全性，且通过终端不动点目标可同时控制动力学和深度行为，从而在测试时实现可靠的深度推理。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the finite-time dynamical regime (settling, marginal, or drifting) of a recurrent operator predicts the benefit of extra test-time iterations, and shows that settling operators guarantee depth-safety, with a terminal fixed-point objective jointly controlling dynamics and depth behavior for reliable deep reasoning.
